action.code: const state = window.__3D_STATE__; const oAtom = state.atoms.find(a => a.element === 'O'); const oBonds = state.getBondsForAtom(oAtom.id); const targetBond = oBonds[0]; const otherAtomId = targetBond.atomA_id === oAtom.id ? targetBond.atomB_id : targetBond.atomA_id; const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width * 0.55, clientY: rect.top + rect.height * 0.5, bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width * 0.65, clientY: rect.top + rect.height * 0.5, bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300));

action.code: const cAtom = window.__3D_STATE__.atoms.find(a => a.element === 'C'); window.__beforeMove = { x: cAtom.x, y: cAtom.y, atomId: cAtom.id }; document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => { if(b.textContent.includes('Move')) b.click(); }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const startX = rect.left + rect.width * 0.45; const startY = rect.top + rect.height * 0.5; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {clientX: startX, clientY: startY, bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', {clientX: startX + 50, clientY: startY - 30, bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {clientX: startX + 50, clientY: startY - 30, bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400));
